name: people_pt
items: A 16-year-old secondary-school student in Braga, Portugal, who helps care for her younger brother and uses AI mainly for homework planning and volleyball training.
A 19-year-old electrical-installation apprentice in Setúbal, Portugal, who left school early and prefers short, practical instructions he can follow on his phone.
A 24-year-old marine-biology master’s student in Horta, Azores, Portugal, who studies plankton and enjoys repairing old film cameras.
A 31-year-old supermarket night-shift worker in Vila Real, Portugal, who is raising a toddler with his partner and often asks for budget meal ideas.
A 38-year-old municipal librarian in Coimbra, Portugal, who runs a reading group for adults learning Portuguese and is meticulous about sources.
A 44-year-old self-employed plumber in Amadora, Portugal, who has dyslexia, records voice prompts, and wants help writing clear quotations for customers.
A 52-year-old hotel housekeeper in Funchal, Madeira, Portugal, who supports an elderly parent and is learning to use spreadsheets for household expenses.
A 61-year-old unemployed former textile-machine operator in Guimarães, Portugal, who is retraining in solar-panel maintenance after his factory closed.
A 70-year-old retired primary-school teacher in Évora, Portugal, who researches local family history and is cautious about sharing personal data online.
A 84-year-old widowed olive grower in a village near Mirandela, Portugal, who uses a tablet with large text and wants weather explanations without technical jargon.
A 17-year-old technical-school student in Manaus, Brazil, who commutes by bus, builds simple robots from discarded electronics, and shares a phone with his sister.
A 22-year-old motorcycle courier in Recife, Brazil, who studies for public-service exams at night and asks for audio-friendly summaries.
A 28-year-old Indigenous community health worker near São Gabriel da Cachoeira, Brazil, who speaks Portuguese and Nheengatu and prepares culturally appropriate clinic notices.
A 34-year-old owner of a small hair-braiding salon in Salvador, Brazil, who employs two relatives and wants polished social-media captions without sounding corporate.
A 39-year-old soybean-farm machinery operator outside Sorriso, Brazil, who completed secondary school and tracks maintenance schedules in WhatsApp messages.
A 46-year-old public defender in Porto Alegre, Brazil, who has two teenage children and uses AI to simplify legal information while checking every citation.
A 53-year-old domestic care worker in São Paulo, Brazil, who looks after an older adult during the week and is completing an online nursing-assistant course.
A 59-year-old artisanal fisher in Cananéia, Brazil, who leads a local cooperative, has limited connectivity, and wants concise information about permits and tides.
A 67-year-old retired bank clerk in Goiânia, Brazil, who recently started learning classical guitar and needs patient guidance with unfamiliar apps.
A 81-year-old former seamstress in Campina Grande, Brazil, who lives with a granddaughter and dictates requests about recipes, medication schedules, and church-community events.
A 18-year-old first-year engineering student in Luanda, Angola, who moved from Huambo, lives with cousins, and relies on low-cost mobile data.
A 27-year-old motorcycle mechanic in Lubango, Angola, who learned the trade informally and wants help diagnosing faults and writing invoices in standard Portuguese.
A 36-year-old midwife at a provincial clinic in Nampula, Mozambique, who coordinates rotating shifts and needs plain-language prenatal materials for families.
A 43-year-old cashew farmer near Ilha de Moçambique, Mozambique, who belongs to a growers’ association and accesses the internet intermittently through a basic smartphone.
A 50-year-old civil-service procurement officer in Maputo, Mozambique, who is taking evening accounting classes and insists on transparent calculations.
A 29-year-old primary-school teacher on Santiago Island, Cabo Verde, who speaks Portuguese and Cape Verdean Creole and creates lessons for a mixed-age classroom.
A 41-year-old guesthouse manager on São Vicente, Cabo Verde, who returned after years abroad and balances tourism work with caring for an aunt.
A 56-year-old cocoa-farming cooperative treasurer near Trindade, São Tomé and Príncipe, who keeps handwritten records and is learning digital bookkeeping.
A 33-year-old radio technician in Bissau, Guinea-Bissau, who repairs community transmitters, supports three children, and prefers step-by-step troubleshooting.
A 72-year-old retired port worker in Mindelo, Cabo Verde, who follows Atlantic shipping news, exchanges voice messages with emigrant family, and has little experience typing.
